bugs.summary: testCacheIDPForLogin registers cleanup for an IdP with the literal alias "alias" instead of the ones it creates (idp-alias-<i>, idp-alias-20), so the created IdPs are never removed and leak into later tests.
bugs.evidence: OrganizationCacheTest.java:374 `idpRep.setAlias("idp-alias-" + i)` then :381 `getCleanup().addCleanup(testRealm().identityProviders().get("alias")::remove)`; same at :419/:425 for idp-alias-20. Golden comments (two sites of one bug, merged).

bugs.summary: update() feeds the organization-aware wrapper from getById as the 'original' model, whose isEnabled() is false while the IdP's organization is disabled; an update that then hides, link-onlys or disables an org-public IdP looks like 'not login before, not login after' and skips login-cache invalidation, so once the organization is re-enabled the cached ORG_ONLY/ALL sets still list the IdP and the login page shows it (the bean only re-checks isEnabled).
bugs.evidence: InfinispanIdentityProviderStorageProvider.java:91 `IdentityProviderModel idpById = getById(...)` returns createOrganizationAwareIdentityProviderModel (:432-446), whose isEnabled() is `org != null && provider.isEnabled() && org.isEnabled() && super.isEnabled()`; :93 passes it to registerIDPLoginInvalidationOnUpdate, which returns early at :405 when neither model passes getLoginPredicate (LoginFilter.ENABLED uses isEnabled). The JPA getForLogin (IdentityProviderStorageProvider.java:165-184) does not filter by organization enabled, so the cached id set holds the IdP; OrganizationAwareIdentityProviderBean re-checks only idp.isEnabled() before display. Found by own review, no model flagged it.

rejected.was: original: InfinispanIdentityProviderStorageProvider.java:246 getForLogin calls session.identityProviders().getById instead of idpDelegate
rejected.why: Re-entering the cache layer is intended: this.getById serves the per-id cached entry and wraps it organization-aware (:122-141). The pre-existing getByOrganization uses the same call (:202, base :190) and upstream main still does at getForLogin. Using idpDelegate would bypass the cache.
